subject: Platform & Inference hiring: queue prioritization and payband guidance
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hiring request — two infra/platform roles (prioritization + payband ask)

Hi Karthik,

We need your quick decision on two open requisitions in the platform/runtime group so we can move to offers next week. Summary below — full details and attachments are in the headcount form and comp matrix I attached.

1) Staff Inference Engineer (L6) — focus: runtime perf, kernel selection, quantization.
   - Proposed band (current): base $240k-$280k, total comp $300k-$360k.
   - Candidate pipeline: 1 strong sourced by Greenbyte (Elena Garcia), several screen-stage internal referrals.
   - Target start: Oct 2026 (dependant on notice).

2) Senior Platform Engineer (L5) — focus: autoscaling/orchestration for Dedicated pools.
   - Proposed band: base $170k-$200k, total comp $220k-$260k.
   - Candidate pipeline: light; plan to open to referrals this week.

Ask: 1) Direction on prioritization (we can only accelerate one this quarter). 2) Permission to extend the Staff role to market-competitive pay (up to +10% on base) if needed to close quickly. 3) Final sign-off to route the Staff candidate from Greenbyte to an offer if interview feedback is green.

Rationale: the Staff hire materially improves throughput on long-tail latency regressions and should reduce infra spend via better batching. Finance has budgeted a Q3 headcount slot but needs exec sign-off on any payband uplift.

Attachments: headcount_request_form_v2.pdf, comp_band_matrix_q3.xlsx, candidate_profile_elena_garcia.pdf

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Platform Recruiting (Working with Runtime/Infra)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hiring request — two infra/platform roles (prioritization + payband ask)

Thanks Marissa — quick questions before I escalate:

- Can you confirm the acceptance probability for the Staff candidate (Elena)? Any competing offers on the table?
- Did Talent run the comp band against market data (SF/NY/SEA)? The matrix looks conservative for L6 inference-specialized folks; we may need to be +15% depending on counteroffers.
- Is this hire replacing a planned slot or adding incremental headcount? Need budget origin for finance.

My initial take: prioritize the Staff Inference Engineer if the candidate pipeline is strong. That role directly reduces ops load and unlocks feature rollout. However, I don't want to pre-approve open-ended payband uplift — route the ask as: approve up to +10% base for Staff now, and I'll loop in Vivek for discretionary uplift beyond that (if needed).

Please reply with: acceptance odds (S/M/L), any active competing offers, and a one-paragraph business impact statement for each role. I'll hold on escalation to Vivek until I see that.

Quoted: 
> We need your quick decision on two open requisitions in the platform/runtime group so we can move to offers next week...

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform & Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hiring request — two infra/platform roles (prioritization + payband ask)

Appreciate the fast read. Answers below and additional context attached.

Staff Inference Engineer (Elena via Greenbyte):
- Acceptance probability: MED-HIGH (3 rounds completed; hiring manager scores 4.4/5). Candidate has an active window with two smaller startups but no confirmed offers yet.
- Comp ask: candidate indicated preference for ~$260k base + equity (prefers faster equity vest schedule).
- Business impact: expected to reduce tail-latency incident rate by ~20% in H1 post-hire via targeted kernel/kv-cache work, which the SRE team estimates will save ~$250k/quarter in cloud spend.

Senior Platform Engineer:
- Acceptance probability: LOW (limited pipeline). Business impact: important for Dedicated autoscaling features but lower near-term ROI compared to Staff inference role.

Budget: This is an incremental slot within the Q3 hiring envelope that was approved for platform growth; Finance requires exec approval for base > band midpoint.

Request: please approve routing an offer to Elena at up to $260k base (which is within the candidate's stated ask) and authorize Marissa to use up to +10% comp uplift if we see a counter. If you want more than +10% base we will need explicit approval from Vivek.

Attachments (again): headcount_request_form_v2.pdf, comp_band_matrix_q3.xlsx, candidate_profile_elena_garcia.pdf

If you prefer a short deck for Vivek, I can spin one up — otherwise please confirm and I'll instruct Talent to draft the offer letter.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Platform Recruiting
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-07T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hiring request — two infra/platform roles (prioritization + payband ask)

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the attachments and the candidate profile. Final decisions:

1) Staff Inference Engineer (Elena) — APPROVED to proceed to offer.
   - Authorization: extend offer up to $260,000 base. Total comp target up to ~$325k with equity and bonus.
   - Conditions: hiring manager sign-off on final package; include standard new-hire clawback clause (first-year prorated). If the candidate receives a counter that pushes base > $260k, pause and I'll discuss with Vivek for discretionary uplift.

2) Senior Platform Engineer (L5) — APPROVE to keep the req open and continue sourcing, but deprioritize immediate offer routing unless we identify candidate with strong immediate impact. No payband uplift approved at this time.

Please have Talent prepare the offer letter and HR paperwork. Kimberly, can you confirm finance entry and update the headcount tracker once the offer goes out? Vivek — looping you for awareness on potential discretionary uplift if counteroffers arrive.

I'll mark this thread as signed-off from my side; if anything changes, call me.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform & Runtime
Redwood Inference
